card.title: Your Turn
card.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I took your bins out once during your holiday. I didn't volunteer for life. Tonight's yours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The neighbours already send you the reminders.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll introduce you in the group as their permanent bin contact.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stay in it until I know what I'm doing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay until you send 'I'll handle Thursday.' They can welcome you while I leave.

mechanism: A turns a one-time bin favor back into B's permanent duty through public acknowledgment in the reminder group.
confusable: Unlike abandoning a shared chore, A must establish that the responsibility was never an ongoing commitment of A's.
comparison: D29-b exits after B states responsibility; D29-a hands over the mop before providing training.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
